findings.description: Unencrypted HTTP repository or package URL detected (risk of MITM attack).
findings.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS with certificate validation (https://) for all package indexes and wheels.

findings.description: VCS dependency declared without commit SHA pin (risk of non-reproducible builds).
findings.recommendation: Pin VCS dependencies to an immutable 40-character commit hash (e.g. git+https://...@commit-sha).

findings.description: Package 'urllib3' uses wildcard or unbounded constraint '>=2.0.0'.
findings.recommendation: Apply an upper-bound constraint or exact pin to prevent unexpected breaking changes.

findings.description: Conflicting specifications for package 'urllib3' found on L8, L9: ['urllib3==1.26.15', 'urllib3>=2.0.0']
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to a single consistent version specification across the project.

findings.description: Duplicate specification for package 'certifi' declared on L12, L14.
Package 'flask' has no version constraint; accepts arbitrary releases.
findings.recommendation: Specify an explicit pinned version constraint (e.g. flask==X.Y.Z).

findings.description: Package 'fastapi' uses wildcard or unbounded constraint '>=0.95.0'.
findings.recommendation: Apply an upper-bound constraint or exact pin to prevent unexpected breaking changes.
